title: The tour photographed a menu and the beats were named for phases they were not showing — both closed, and the class closed with them

verified.--ui-tour, BEFORE (artifacts/G4_tour_bef: 11 failures of 17 steps; all eleven PNGs are [P24]'s main menu at ~49 KB each; 45 of the 55 possible pairs are the same picture to within 0.00005 of a luma stop (measured independently in Python, and by the new DIFF guard, which reports the identical 45/55)
verified.--ui-tour, AFTER (artifacts/G4_tour_afte: 0 failures of 17 steps, 0 guard failures, 11 shots at 1.8-2.5 MB, 0 pairs indistinguishable. Every screen opens, all three lenses arm, sim speed 2 takes, Space pauses
verified.the cause: LcnMetaRoot._should_open_title() reads --ui-tour off OS.get_cmdline_user_args(), which is EMPTY unless the command line carries a bare `--`; every documented invocation omits one. boot.gd's cli_args() unions both lists and started the tour anyway, so the menu opened over it, took the keyboard and ate every hotkey
verified.--ui-tour --keep-chrome (artifacts/G4_to: the control. 12 step failures, 11 CHROME failures naming 'LcnMetaRoot (layer 80)', and DIFF reporting '45 of 55 the interface photographs are the same picture'. Exit 1. Both guards go red against the exact defect they were written for
verified.first_night beats, BEFORE (artifacts/G4_: midday->DUSK, dusk->NIGHT, assault->DEEP NIGHT with 0 enemies alive (the last one died at t6800), deep_night->MORNING of day 2, dawn->MORNING, second_dusk->NIGHT, second_night->DAWN of day 3. Six of eleven wrong, exactly as the brief reported
verified.first_night beats, AFTER (artifacts/G4_v: all eleven photograph the moment they name. midday t3400->t2207 afternoon; dusk t5500->t3839 dusk; deep_night t8800->t6911 deep night; dawn t9800->t8063 dawn d2; second_dusk t15200->t13439 dusk d2; second_night t17600->t14879 night d2; assault armed t7200, fired t13920 with 10 hostiles alive at night. 0 errors, 22 PNGs
verified.the cause: ClimateProfile.opening_tick = 2016, so a run begins mid-morning; every hand-written shot tick predates that change by roughly a phase
verified.tests/gate/test_shot_beats.gd (new): 4 tests. The forecast is held against a real ClimateSystem stepped tick by tick across all 9 shipped scenarios (including smoke, whose skip_to_phase commands the forecast has to model) and they agree on every tick
verified.FALSIFICATION — LcnHarness.aim reverted: the gate names all six mislabelled first_night beats by name, plus second_night's wrong DAY, plus smoke/dawn_wide, plus the excuse-rot check. 9 failures. Restored and green
verified.FALSIFICATION — era_title() reverted to: tests/gate/test_era_line.gd fails with 'a Great Frost is blowing and the line under the day number reads The Lull' — the critic's sentence, reproduced by the suite. Restored and green
verified.FALSIFICATION — the DIFF guard caught MY: the first .world variants still contained the whole HUD (strip sets visible=false; capture reads a frame the GPU has already drawn), so they sat 1-4 grey levels from the shot they were meant to differ from. The first fix written was an exemption for same-family pairs. That was wrong; the guard was right. After splitting strip/capture and stripping BEFORE the redraw, all 231 pairs of artifacts/G4_vis3 are distinct and the closest is 0.00966 against a 0.002 threshold — 5x headroom, no exemption anywhere
verified.tests/gate/test_screenshot_guards.gd (ne: 6 tests. Censuses every .gd under game/, tests/ and tools/ that reads the framebuffer (12 files) and fails one carrying neither guard that is not registered. A new screenshot tool cannot be born blind
verified.tests/gate/test_era_line.gd (new): 4 tests. era_title() names the storm while one blows, the escalation beat otherwise, and goes back when it passes; era_key/era_index do not follow the weather
verified.full in-process suite: 92 suites, 1270 passed, 1 failed, 102630 asserts. The one failure is tests/production/test_a_great_frost_slows_the_factory_down and it is NOT mine — it fails identically with HEAD~1's climate_system.gd swapped back in
verified.run_visual.sh --scenario=smoke (the run: exit 0, 10 shots, 0 guard failures, and one loud WARN that smoke/dawn_wide cannot be photographed

open: INTEGRATOR: game/play/ui_tour.gd is now dead — boot loads res://tools/ui_tour.gd by path instead. It still holds `class_name LcnUiTour` and nothing references it. Delete it, and delete its row from tests/gate/screenshot_paths.json when you do; the gate asserts the two stay in step.

INTEGRATOR / whoever owns tools/gen_scenarios.py: tests/scenarios/smoke.json names its first beat `dawn_wide` at tick 40, and smoke is 600 ticks starting at opening_tick 2016 (morning) — it never reaches dawn. The scenario scripts skip_to_phase for the other five phases and not for this one. The harness now refuses to photograph it rather than writing a PNG called dawn_wide that shows morning, so the run stays green and writes 10 shots instead of 12. Fix is one line in the scenario (add a skip_to_phase dawn before tick 40, or rename the beat). It is recorded in tests/gate/screenshot_paths.json -> misnamed_beats, which is capped at 1 and asserted to still be true.

NINE PARTS OWE A GUARD. tests/gate/screenshot_paths.json lists every file that reads the framebuffer without CHROME or DIFF: [P17] tests/hud/shoot.gd, [P20] tests/stats/shoot.gd, [P14] tests/vfx/vfx_gpu.gd, [P15] tests/feel/feel_gallery.gd, [P13] tests/render/night_contrast.gd, [P24] tests/meta/run_meta_ui.gd and game/ui/meta/save_manager.gd, [D2] tests/items_view/item_frames.gd, [P18] game/ui/build_menu/build_menu_root.gd. Each is one call: `var shutter := LcnShutter.new(<ceiling>, "<subject>")`, `shutter.shoot(get_tree(), name)`, `for line in shutter.failures(): fail(line)`. The list may only shrink — max_blind is 10 and the suite fails if it grows. [P24]'s save thumbnail is the one worth doing first: it is grabbed while the save browser is open, so every thumbnail in the browser is a picture of the browser.

[P13]: tests/render/frame_lab.gd still carries the guards inline and is registered that way (chrome at _strip_chrome, diff at _print_delta, both asserted to still exist). Moving it onto LcnShutter would delete ~60 lines and pick up the `draws()` fix — a CanvasLayer that is visible but holds nothing visible is NOT chrome, and the frame lab's guard would call it chrome today.

[P17]: the clock plate now gets the storm's name under the day number while a Great Frost blows. It is drawn with style.fs(9) in caps and 'The First Great Frost' is 21 characters against 'The Lull' at 8 — worth a look at whether it fits the corner.

NOT VERIFIED BY ME: tools/check.sh end to end (40+ min, and the box has had two to four other agents on it all session). I ran its pieces — parse check, the full in-process suite, determinism, reachability, lint_sim, and the smoke visual run tools/gate.sh makes — and every one is green except the pre-existing production failure above. Perf was not measured and must not be read off anything I ran.

NOT VERIFIED BY ME: the 'THE LULL' fix in a real first_night run, because first_night at seed 7 never raises a Great Frost (climate.storm_intensity is 0.000 on every row of artifacts/G4_base/metrics.csv) and its narrative never reaches the_great_frost. The fix is verified by force_storm in tests/gate/test_era_line.gd and falsified against the old code; a scenario that actually blows one would be a better witness.
